name: Mr Bandages
source:
“I play to win.”

They say he’s cold, but he’s really short-tempered and brash, always getting his bandages in a twist.

[From [url=http://synokoria.tumblr.com/Halloween_Otome]official site[/url]]

[spoiler]His real name is Landon Rivera. Formerly a professional photographer, he is now a famous menswear model.[/spoiler]
